:::{#exm-lp-space}
#### The zero element of $L^p$

Let $f$ be the function in @exm-equal-almost-everywhere, which is $1$ at $s = 0$ and $0$ elsewhere.
Then $f = 0$ $\measure$-a.e., so $[f] = [0]$.
Also $\norm{f}_p = 0$ even though $f \neq 0$,
so $\norm{\cdot}_p$ is not definite on $\mathcal{L}^p$;
on $L^p(\measure)$, $\norm{[f]}_p = 0$ only for $[f] = [0]$,
as the definiteness axiom of a [norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-norm) requires.

:::
